svg.aria-label: Two L40S GPUs next to one wafer, each holding Qwen3.5-9B. Each L40S has 48 GB with 4.8 GB reserved, 18 GB of weights and 22 requests of 1.13 GB, read at 864 GB/s, about 21 ms to read the weights once. The wafer has 44 GB with 18 GB of weights and 23 requests, read at about 21 PB/s, under 1 microsecond. The two GPUs are linked by PCIe Gen4 with no NVLink.
